corpus_source: data/distill/teacher_v7.jsonl (2350 synthetic + 39 production sft-clean + 13 production sft-corrected; deduped by prompt)

hyperparams.note: Halved LoRA capacity vs v5 (r16/a32) to fight over-fit; one fewer epoch.

release_notes: Ties v4 on the 20-prompt held-out battery (20/20). Brings two material improvements over v4: (a) first release trained on production telemetry (52 turns from khayyammath.com under ToS §5 anonymisation), (b) more recent corpus snapshot. Inference latency unchanged.
relation_to_v5_rejected: Same corpus as v5; halved LoRA capacity (rank 16->8, alpha 32->16) and one fewer epoch fixed the over-fit that caused v5 to regress on 5 prompts.
extractor_fix_dependency: Releases pre-fix khayyam_math < 0.4.1 may see 3/20 of the figures rendered as escaped-text-in-XML due to a known JSON-newline extractor bug. The 0.4.1 release ships an unescape fallback. Use khayyam_math >= 0.4.1.
